title: Live article /articles/venue-driver/ shows [DRAFT] body; 11 stub solution pages 301 to it
description:
**Problem**
The live page https://anth.us/articles/venue-driver/ has "[DRAFT]" as its body. Eleven stub solution pages (Checkout-Driver, Menu-Driver, ...) are published as "[DRAFT]" and 301 redirect to it. The article excerpt is also run together.

**Evidence**
`curl -sL https://anth.us/articles/venue-driver/ | grep -o '\[DRAFT\]'` prints "[DRAFT]" (HTTP 200, re-checked 2026-10-20).

**Fix**
Write the Venue Driver article body (mind the claims-honesty rule: no present-tense production claims), or unpublish it and the stub pages and remove the redirects. Fix the excerpt spacing.

**How to verify**
`curl -sL https://anth.us/articles/venue-driver/ | grep -c '\[DRAFT\]'` prints 0, or the URL returns 404/410 if unpublished.

Source: Anthus repo audit, 2026-10-20.
